datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Zimbabwe in 2019. Geographic data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing food insecurity classifications at multiple time points (February, June, October) under different scenarios, with each record containing classification scale, collection date, and food security phase assignments.
